# The Quillmark

> Housing, tech, gaming, streaming, home repair and deals news in one front page, with every story linked to its source.

Hub of the samcbarth.com network. Section headlines link to the network site that published them; stories under /story/ are written here and cite primary sources.

## Sections
- [Real Estate](https://news.samcbarth.com/section/real-estate/): Mortgage rates, home sales, rents and investing news, with a Texas and Oklahoma lens. Source site: https://realestate.samcbarth.com/
- [Tools and Tech](https://news.samcbarth.com/section/tools-tech/): Software, AI and web tools news for marketers, developers and small business owners. Source site: https://tools.samcbarth.com/
- [Gaming](https://news.samcbarth.com/section/gaming/): Release dates, industry moves and platform news from the games business. Source site: https://games.samcbarth.com/
- [Streaming](https://news.samcbarth.com/section/streaming/): Prices, bundles, devices and what changes for subscribers. Source site: https://streaming.samcbarth.com/
- [Home](https://news.samcbarth.com/section/home/): Recalls, permits, codes and costs that affect DIY home repair. Source site: https://homerepair.samcbarth.com/
- [Deals](https://news.samcbarth.com/section/deals/): Retail seasons, sale events and shopping data, without the countdown clocks. Source site: https://deals.samcbarth.com/

## Hub stories
- [Adobe expects Black Friday online sales of $12.9 billion, growing faster than Cyber Monday](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/adobe-forecast-black-friday-12-9-billion/): Adobe's holiday forecast puts U.S. online spending at a record $275.1 billion for November and December, with the deepest discounts during Cyber Week.
- [Walmart's first Black Friday deals event starts November 12](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/walmart-early-black-friday-deals-november-12/): Walmart is running three holiday sale events this year: early deals Nov. 12 to 15, Black Friday deals Nov. 23 to 29 and Cyber Monday deals Nov. 30 to Dec. 2.
- [Spotify reaches 306 million paying subscribers and 788 million users](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/spotify-q3-2026-306-million-subscribers/): Spotify's third-quarter results show growth in every region, with revenue of 5.0 billion euros and operating income ahead of its own forecast.
- [Pikmin 4 Switch 2 Edition with Dandori Academy arrives November 12](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/pikmin-4-switch-2-edition-november-12/): Nintendo's upgraded Pikmin 4 adds sharper visuals, voice commands for Oatchi and a 72-stage challenge mode released over time.
- [Football Manager 27 is out on PC, consoles, Netflix and Apple Arcade](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/football-manager-27-launches/): Sports Interactive released all four versions of FM27 on November 10, including through Game Pass, Netflix and Apple Arcade subscriptions.
- [Chrome 157 update fixes a flaw Google says is being exploited](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/chrome-157-fixes-exploited-zero-day/): Google's November 9 desktop update patches nine security bugs, including a high-severity use-after-free in Chrome's XML code with a known exploit.
- [Windows 11 November update KB5132061 turns on NTLM signing by default](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/windows-11-november-2026-update-kb5132061/): Microsoft's November security update for Windows 11 tightens NTLM and PowerShell script signing and fixes USB audio and printer bugs.
- [Home improvement spending expected to stay flat through late 2027](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/harvard-lira-remodeling-spending-flat-2027/): Harvard's remodeling forecast projects 1.5% growth to about $527 billion, citing flat building-product sales and stalled remodeling permits.
- [EIA: heating oil bills to rise 21% this winter while natural gas bills fall 9%](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/eia-winter-heating-oil-bills-up-21-percent/): The federal energy agency's winter outlook splits sharply by fuel, so what a household pays depends on how the home is heated.
- [Homes for sale rose 7.4% in October as contract signings fell 17%](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/realtor-com-october-inventory-up-7-4-percent/): Realtor.com's October report shows more listings sitting on the market and fewer buyers signing contracts as mortgage rates held above 7%.
- [Skydance plans a combined Paramount+ and HBO Max streamer for early 2027](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/skydance-plans-paramount-hbo-max-streamer/): The company told shareholders the merged service would come at one price. It did not give the price.
- [Denver launches an AI tool that pre-checks building permit applications](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/denver-launches-ai-permit-intake-check/): StartSmart flags missing items before an application goes to city staff. Staff still make the final call.
- [OpenAI agrees to acquire Pierre, maker of Code Storage, to build out Codex](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/openai-to-acquire-pierre-code-storage/): Pierre's open-source developer libraries will stay open source, and current Code Storage customers can keep using it after the deal closes.
- [Grand Theft Auto VI is 10 days out: what to know about the Nov. 19 launch](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/gta-vi-launch-date-november-19/): Rockstar's release date has held since it moved from May, making it the biggest game launch of the holiday season.
- [Mortgage rates dip to 7.18% in Freddie Mac's Nov. 5 survey](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/mortgage-rates-dip-to-7-18-percent/): The 30-year fixed average fell for a third straight week, but it is still almost a full point above where it sat a year ago.
- [Existing-home sales rose 1.5% in September as inventory climbed](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/existing-home-sales-rise-in-september/): NAR counted a 3.99 million annual sales pace, with the median price up 1.3% from a year earlier to $417,500.
- [NRF forecasts 2026 holiday sales will top $1 trillion](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/nrf-forecasts-holiday-sales-above-1-trillion/): The retail trade group expects November and December sales to grow 4.2% over 2025, with up to 375,000 seasonal hires.
